title: The Laughing Cave and the Starroot Treasure
moral: True treasure is meant to be shared.

scenes.text: Bramble discovers a map leading to a legendary treasure called Starroot.
scenes.image_prompt: bear holding map inside hollow tree with fox beside him

scenes.text: They follow clues but must prove their intentions are kind and selfless.
scenes.image_prompt: river with glowing pebble guiding explorers

scenes.text: They solve river riddles and follow clues through forests and ridges.
scenes.image_prompt: forest path with tall pine tree and glowing symbols

scenes.text: They cross thorny paths and continue despite challenges.
scenes.image_prompt: fox and bear navigating thorny forest path carefully

scenes.text: They find the treasure and choose to share it with everyone.
scenes.image_prompt: glowing treasure inside cave with bear and fox smiling

story: Bramble and Juniper follow a magical map to find the Starroot treasure. Through kindness and teamwork, they prove that true treasure should benefit everyone.
